channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Scott Burrell | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Scott Burrell from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Randy Brown on Steve Kerr, Phil Jackson, Ron Harper, John Salley, Toni Kukoc, Jud Buechler, Luc Longley, Bill Wennington, Jason Caffey, Scott Burrell
item.description:
Randy Brown:

“It would be an honor for the Bulls fans to see Michael, Scottie and Dennis. Phil Jackson. Steve Kerr. Toni Kukoc, Ron Harper, Luc Longley, Bill Wennington, Jud Buechler, John Salley, Buddha Edwards, Scott Burrell, Jason Caffey. I had some great teammates along the way, and Bulls fans would love to acknowledge that this is a championship city.“I’m not going to let it go. I’m hoping it will happen sooner rather than later. Even though everyone’s read in the media about Michael and Scottie’s differences, all that stuff, I hope it can all come to fruition, that we can hug each other one last time. And then from there, we can see where it goes.”

Randy Brown on Steve Kerr, Phil Jackson, Ron Harper, John Salley, Toni Kukoc, Jud Buechler, Luc Longley, Bill Wennington, Jason Caffey, Scott Burrell, Dec 19, 2025. Source: ESportsBets.

item.title: Ron Harper on Scott Burrell
item.description:
Harper:

“I mean, MJ knew who he could talk to and who he had to push. He was one of those guys who made you work hard because you see how he worked. It made you work harder. There were some guys he would pick on. But I didn’t think it was in a way that was harmful or bullying. It just that you ain’t going to talk crap about me. When he was talking to Scott Burrell, Scott wasn’t man enough to stand up for who he was. You ain’t doing that shit to me.”

Ron Harper on Scott Burrell, May 20, 2020. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Horace Grant on Steve Kerr, Will Perdue, Scott Burrell
item.description:
“Because whenever he went at me, I went at him right back. But in terms of Will Perdue, Steve Kerr and the young man, Scott Burrell, that was heartbreaking [to watch].To see a guy, a leader, to go at those guys like that. I understand in terms of practicing, you have a push and shove here and there, but outright punching and things of that nature. And calling them the B's and the H's, that wasn't called for.”

Horace Grant on Steve Kerr, Will Perdue, Scott Burrell, May 19, 2020. Source: ESPN.
